name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: The browser's own select in the dashboard's field: 40px, control corners, a light border and the up-down chevron.
usage: Choose one value where the platform picker serves better than a custom menu: phones, very long lists (countries, time zones), or forms that must work before script loads. Use NativeSelectOption and NativeSelectOptGroup; give it a name to submit with the form.
avoid: Styling the open list (the browser draws it)
A native select beside custom selects in the same form
Placeholder text as the only label

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
